+- **README drift** — this document no longer matches the code in several
+  places and needs correction (see the audit in the next few bullets):
+  - **Clippy is not clean** — the README claims
+    `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` passes. It does
+    not: `tool.rs` has an unused `crate::debug` import, and `agent.rs`
+    `run_streaming_loop` takes 8 arguments (`clippy::too_many_arguments`).
+    Fix the code or drop the claim.
+  - **`--max-turns` defaults wrong** — the config table says 10 (50 in task
+    mode). The CLI (`main.rs`) sets both `DEFAULT_MAX_TURNS` and
+    `TASK_MAX_TURNS` to 1000.
+  - **Undocumented CLI flags** — `--prompt`, `--prompt-file`, and
+    `--new-prompt` exist in `main.rs` but are absent from the config and REPL
+    docs.
+  - **`run_command` allowlist mismatch** — the tool description and README
+    advertise read-only `cargo`/`git` verbs, but `check_command_argv` also
+    permits `git add`, `git commit`, ~90 non-mutating Unix commands, wider
+    git inspection verbs, and `find`. This contradicts the "write tools are
+    opt-in" security boundary. Align the description with the code or narrow
+    the allowlist.
+  - **Duplicated TODO** — the `add_ignore tool / --regenerate-ignore` bullet
+    appears twice in this section. Keep one.
